title: 第14章 大仙等等！
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
清风宗灵石矿场在一偏僻的山里。

    单单风景还是颇为怡人，青山绿水环绕，林间还有不少浅开灵智的妖兽。

    不知道是为了防止矿工逃跑还是怕妖兽来袭。

    围绕矿场还布置有简单的迷魂阵，筑基期以下修士依靠自身恐怕极难离开被阵法包裹的矿场。

    楚星尘根据厉行天的说法，这里挖矿的大部分都是些资质极差的修士。

    清风宗是从各个偏僻村子，穷乡僻里的地方找到的人。

    一来这种人不可能有大背景，不会招惹到不能招惹的人。

    二来穷乡僻里，哪怕人回不去，也不会遭到质疑。

    只要有点灵根，哪怕再杂都会收走。

    再用燃烧潜力的药浴强行炼气二三层，就直接扔到矿场挖矿，至死方休。

    所以清风宗大概就是披着正道宗门的皮，实际上却干着邪修的事情。

    毕竟这种事情，怎么可能瞒得过清风宗掌门等一系列高层？

    楚星尘小心绕开正门修士巡查的地方。

    从一侧的山崖翻上，尽量隐蔽自身气息，楚星尘缓缓观测下面矿场情况。

    几座简单大木屋杂乱排列没有规律计划，但在最高处有一栋精美建筑，能看见清风宗服饰的弟子。

    人数不多，两男一女。

    如果不用神识扫描，已不能探测他们的境界修为，那么这群清风宗弟子修为应该筑基。

    筑基以后修士就能轻易操控灵气藏于体内，不再外露。

    如果不用神识扫描，单凭肉眼，金丹境界还是不能看出来的。

    此刻白天正是挖掘时刻，矿洞内时常响起剧烈声响。

    时不时就有衣衫褴褛的炼气修士在用简易推车搬运开采出来的灵石粗矿。

    这群挖矿的修士修为果然不高，探测结果也就炼气二三层。

    看着他们将一车车的灵石粗矿运到一个加工棚下。

    几个挥着大锤的炼气修士在奋力的敲击石块，将其中的矿渣和灵石分开来。

    清风宗弟子双手靠着面前的围栏，神色戏谑的看着那群挖矿的人。

    楚星尘目光扫过，迅速锁定了一个仓库模样的建筑，占地很大，但奇怪的是没有任何护卫左右。

    根据厉行天所说的金丹修士恐怕就坐镇其中。

    强攻必然不是明智之举，此处必然很可能拥有联系宗门的手段。

    要么速胜，要么引诱。

    不过这次来本身也只是为了探探具体情况，没有打算下手。

    楚星尘从空间戒指中拿出纸笔，迅速对照着路线和建筑大概，画起了草图。

    拿着草图再回去和厉行天仔细商量，看看具体什么情况。
content_en:
The Qingfeng Sect Lingshi Mine is in a remote mountain.

The scenery alone is quite pleasant, surrounded by green mountains and green waters, and there are many monsters with a little enlightenment in the forest.

I don’t know if it is to prevent the miners from escaping or to prevent the monsters from attacking.

There is also a simple ecstasy formation surrounding the mine. It would be extremely difficult for monks below the foundation-building stage to leave the mine surrounded by the formation on their own.

According to Chu Xingchen, according to Li Xingtian, most of the people mining here are monks with extremely poor qualifications.

The Qingfeng Sect found people from various remote villages and remote places.

First of all, this kind of person cannot have a big background and will not provoke people who cannot be provoked.

Secondly, in a remote and remote area, even if one cannot return, one will not be questioned.

As long as there is some spiritual root, no matter how complicated it is, it will be taken away.

Then use a medicinal bath with burning potential to forcibly refine the gas to the second and third levels, and then throw it directly into the mine for mining until death.

Therefore, the Qingfeng Sect probably wears the guise of a righteous sect, but is actually doing evil things.

After all, how could such a thing be hidden from the head of Qingfeng Sect and other high-level officials?

Chu Xingchen carefully avoided the main entrance where the monks were patrolling.

Climbing up the cliff on one side, trying to hide his aura as much as possible, Chu Xingchen slowly observed the situation in the mine below.

Several simple large wooden houses are arranged haphazardly with no regular plan, but there is an exquisite building at the top where you can see the disciples of Qingfeng Sect in costumes.

There were not many people, two men and one woman.

If it is impossible to detect their realm cultivation level without scanning with spiritual consciousness, then the cultivation level of these Qingfeng Sect disciples should be established.

After establishing the foundation, the monk can easily control the spiritual energy to be hidden in the body and no longer exposed.

Without spiritual scanning, the golden elixir realm cannot be seen with the naked eye alone.

It was the excavation time during the day, and there were often loud noises in the mine.

From time to time, there would be ragged Qi Refining monks using simple carts to transport the mined rough spiritual stones.

The cultivation level of this group of mining monks is indeed not high, and the detection results are only at the second or third level of Qi Refining.

Watch them transport cartloads of crude spiritual stone ore to a processing shed.

Several Qi Refining monks wielding sledgehammers were pounding the stones hard to separate the slag and spiritual stones.

The Qingfeng Sect disciple leaned against the fence in front of him with his hands and looked at the group of miners with a playful expression.

Chu Xingchen glanced over and quickly locked onto a warehouse-like building. It occupied a large area, but strangely there were no guards around.

According to what Li Xingtian said, the Golden elixir monk is probably sitting among them.

It is definitely not a wise move to attack by force. There must be a way to contact the sect here.

Either quick victory or seduction.

However, I came here just to explore the specific situation and had no intention of taking action.

Chu Xingchen took out a pen and paper from his space ring, quickly compared the route and building outline, and drew a sketch.

Take the sketch and go back to discuss it carefully with Li Xingtian to see what the specific situation is.
